items.note: 複數 → were；動詞第三型 shipped。
已經被核准 → has been + V-ed。

items.q: The samples ______ right now; results will be ready at 3 p.m.
items.note: 正在被測 → are being + V-ed。

items.q: This spec ______ without the customer's approval.

groups.title: B　句型 ④⑤ 與固定搭配

items.q: They gave us a 5% discount. → We ______ a 5% discount.
They made us redo the test. → We were made ______ the test.
We are very interested ______ your new connector series.

groups.title: C　中翻英：先想重點是人還是東西

items.a: The meeting has been rescheduled to Friday.
items.note: 重點是會議 → 被動；已經 → has been。

items.q: 樣品在運送過程中被弄壞了。
items.a: The samples were damaged during shipping. / The samples got damaged during shipping.

items.q: 這個零件是在越南生產的。
items.a: This part is made in Vietnam.

items.q: 我昨天已經把報價寄給你了。（做的人是你）
items.a: I sent you the quotation yesterday. / I've already sent you the quotation.
items.note: 做的人是自己 → 主動，不要 was sent by me。

items.q: 零件應該今天要到的，但還沒到。
items.a: The parts are supposed to arrive today, but they haven't yet.
